tools.name: find_free_tool
tools.description: Search SendPay Business's library of 170+ free calculators, checkers and generators for small businesses, freelancers, banking, FX, trading and crypto (invoice generator, VAT, card fees, loan, mortgage, IBAN, SWIFT, forex, bitcoin and more). Returns matching tools with links. Use it when the user ne

tools.name: vat_calculator
tools.description: Add VAT to a net price, or remove VAT from a gross (VAT-inclusive) price, at any rate. UK standard rate is 20%, reduced 5%.

tools.name: card_fee_calculator
tools.description: Work out the fee on a card payment (percentage plus fixed fee), what you keep, and what to charge to receive the full amount after fees.

tools.name: profit_margin_calculator
tools.description: Profit, margin and markup from cost and selling price; or the selling price needed for a target margin.

tools.name: percentage_calculator
tools.description: Three sums: X% of Y ('percent_of'), what percent X is of Y ('what_percent'), and percentage change from X to Y ('change').

tools.name: discount_calculator
tools.description: Sale price after a percentage discount and, given unit cost and units normally sold, how many extra sales the discount needs to keep the same profit.

tools.name: roi_calculator
tools.description: Return on investment: profit and ROI % from the amount put in and the amount got back, and the yearly rate if the time in months is given.

tools.name: compound_interest_calculator
tools.description: Savings growth with monthly compounding and an optional monthly deposit: final balance, total paid in and interest earned.

tools.name: loan_repayment_calculator
tools.description: Monthly repayment, total repaid and total interest on a fixed-rate loan, from the amount, APR and term in months.

tools.name: mortgage_calculator
tools.description: Monthly repayment mortgage payment, loan-to-value, total interest and interest-only payment from property price, deposit, rate and term.

tools.name: hourly_rate_calculator
tools.description: What a freelancer or sole trader should charge per hour and per day to reach a target yearly income after business costs and time off.

tools.name: break_even_calculator
tools.description: How many sales a month cover fixed costs, from fixed monthly costs, price, cost per unit and payment fee percent.

tools.name: iban_checker
tools.description: Check that an IBAN is well formed: country length and mod-97 check digits. Does not confirm that the account exists or who owns it.

tools.name: swift_code_checker
tools.description: Check that a SWIFT (BIC) code is well formed and split it into bank, country, location and branch. Has no bank directory.

tools.name: free_business_website
tools.description: Use when the user wants a website for their business, shop or side hustle. SendPay Business offers a free business website builder: free to build, publish and keep, no card needed, with an optional shop cart and card payments later. Returns the link to start.

tools.name: lei_checker
tools.description: Check that a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI, ISO 17442) is well formed: 20 characters and MOD 97-10 check digits. Does not confirm the LEI is registered; GLEIF's search does.

tools.name: isin_checker
tools.description: Check that an ISIN (ISO 6166 security identifier) is well formed: country code, 9-character national code and Luhn check digit.

tools.name: cusip_checker
tools.description: Check a 9-character CUSIP (US/Canadian security identifier) check digit and split it into issuer and issue.

tools.name: sedol_checker
tools.description: Check a 7-character SEDOL (UK/Irish security identifier) format and check digit.

tools.name: uk_vat_number_checker
tools.description: Check a UK VAT number's format and check digits (9 digits, 12 with a branch, or GD/HA). Does not confirm registration; HMRC's service does.

tools.name: cbu_checker
tools.description: Check an Argentine CBU or CVU: 22 digits and both check digits, split into bank, branch and account.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cusip_checker · Public sink: free_business_website · Destructive: vat_calculator, sedol_checker, uk_vat_number_checker.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cusip_checker · Public sink: free_business_website · Destructive: vat_calculator, sedol_checker, uk_vat_number_checker

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
